args.text: Hi June, Dana Okafor has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines, for the territory review. Dana will send it herself. Hollis isn't the CFO, deal desk or the account owner, so I need your OK (or Anselm's) before I put the rate in a mail to him. Is that approved?

Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner without sign-off, and Hollis is the Central team lead, so a deal-desk approval is needed first. That applies to drafts too, since the draft would hold the figure.

I've messaged June to ask for approval and logged the request. Once June or Anselm says yes, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and the $2,356-per-seat figure, and leave it for you to send. If the territory review doesn't need the rate itself, I can draft it without the figure now.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks @Ilse Varga, noted. You'll be on the road tomorrow morning (Thu Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. I checked your calendar and there's nothing booked for tomorrow, so no meetings clash. Safe travels! If you'd like me to block the morning on your calendar or pass anything along to the team, just say.

I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team. I said I'd noted that they're on the road tomorrow morning (Thursday, October 15) and reachable on mobile.

I checked their calendar for tomorrow and nothing is booked, so their travel won't clash with any meetings. I also offered to block the morning on their calendar or pass a message to the team, but haven't done either because they didn't ask.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.

For your reference: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,356 per seat.

Best,
Anselm

args.text: Done. I saved a draft in your mailbox to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356/seat figure Dana passed on to you. I haven't sent it, so you can check it and send it yourself.

I saved a draft email to Hollis Mbeki in Anselm's mailbox and told Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent; Anselm will send it.

- **Draft:** It goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356-per-seat figure Dana passed on.
- **Finance rule:** The per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, so it can only go to Hollis with sign-off from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and allowed it in his message, so I didn't open a separate approval request.
- **Address rule:** Hollis's address is on pemberline.com, so Ruth didn't need to approve it.
- **Not checked:** I didn't compare the $2,356 against the Quarrendon files. I used the figure Anselm gave me.
